# Verification of Compile

The verify feature enables users to check the integrity of the current code state against a previously compiled version. This ensures that the codebase hasn't diverged unexpectedly since the last successful compile, providing a safeguard against unnoticed changes.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
